implementation: Independent formula adapters; upstream code not vendored
scope: User-approved fixed-PE subset; no learned FFN, table embeddings or training
coordinate_domain: Global lon/lat chart for planar encoders; unit sphere for xyz/NeRF; explicit per-method units
single_scale_extension: For geometric rules S=1 uses min_radius; SphereM+/DFS S=1 uses frequency 1
adaptations: No trained FFN/SIREN or table embeddings
RBF center presets are synthetic and replayable; not sampled from a training dataset
Explicit S=1 continuation instead of upstream division by zero
FP64 formulas and integration for geometry; no claim of bitwise equivalence to upstream FP32
Global lon/lat extent fixed for wrap and RFF
SphereM+ and DFS retain their pinned implementation frequency rule, which does not use min_radius
existing_sh_note: Existing globe SH uses the common real 4pi basis and canonical angles. Full-degree subspaces are comparable, but channelwise signs/angles are not claimed to reproduce upstream SH; no trained Siren(SH).
